title: Craving
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 27.8 Linked Discourses 27.8
  • 1. Kilesavagga 1. Corruptions

Taṇhāsutta Craving

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Yo, bhikkhave, rūpataṇhāya chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso. “Mendicants, desire and greed for craving for sights, Yo saddataṇhāya … craving for sounds, yo gandhataṇhāya … craving for smells, yo rasataṇhāya … craving for tastes, yo phoṭṭhabbataṇhāya … craving for touches, yo dhammataṇhāya chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso. or craving for ideas is a corruption of the mind. …” Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno …pe… abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū”ti.

Aṭṭhamaṁ.
